blocks.html: Follow Along: Log In Now. Before we begin, please open a new tab and log in to one.zoho.com. While you can also access the system via crm.zoho.com, we use the Zoho One layout for all our training guides. The features are identical in both, but the navigation menus are located in different places. Logging into the "One" view now will ensure your screen matches these lessons.

The CRM Philosophy: Our "Source of Truth"

At OneAccord, Zoho CRM is more than just a digital rolodex; it is the central nervous system of our business. Our "Source of Truth" philosophy means that if an interaction, a meeting note, or a deal status isn't in Zoho, it effectively didn't happen. By keeping all data in one place, we ensure:

  • Seamless Collaboration: Any Principal can step in to support a deal with full context.
  • Growth Loop Integrity: Our automated referral asks only work if our data is accurate.
  • Historical Memory: We maintain a permanent record of our relationships that outlasts any single email thread.

Navigation Mastery: Suite vs. Workspace

Zoho One (one.zoho.com) — The Suite: Think of this as your Dashboard. It is the unified interface that gives you access to every Zoho app we use (CRM, Campaigns, Bookings, etc.) in one browser tab. This is the view we will be using throughout this training.

Zoho CRM (crm.zoho.com) — The Workspace: This is your Engine Room. It focuses exclusively on the sales pipeline, contacts, and accounts.

blocks.html:
The Top Bar: Your Universal Tools

The icons at the top of your screen are your "Quick Access" tools available from any page.

  • Global Search: Type a name, phone number, or company. Zoho searches across all modules.
  • The Plus (+) Icon: Your "Quick Create." Use this to add a new Task, Meeting, or Inquiry without leaving your current page.
  • The Bell (Notifications): Your command center for alerts, mentions from colleagues, or task reminders.
  • Zia (The AI Assistant): Ask Zia questions like "What is my revenue for this month?"

blocks.label: Find it now
blocks.instructions: Hover your mouse over the Plus (+) icon at the top right. Notice how many different types of records you can create instantly.

blocks.html:
The Bottom Bar: Real-Time Communication

The bottom of your screen stays pinned as you navigate:

  • Cliq (Chats & Channels): An internal communication tool.
  • Recent Items: Click the clock icon to see the last five records you visited.
  • Reminders: The alarm clock icon shows activities due right now.

The Menu: The CRM Modules

The sidebar (or top menu depending on your view) organizes our data. We primarily use:

  • Contact: Individual people.
  • Account: The companies those people work for.
  • Referral Partners: A list of people or companies who refer business to us.
  • Tasks, Meetings, & Calls: Your daily activity logs.

blocks.prompt: True or False: If I have a great meeting with a prospect but don't log it in Zoho, it still counts toward my performance metrics.
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Right — if it isn't in Zoho, it didn't happen. Untracked meetings don't count toward your metrics.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Not quite — at OneAccord, if it isn't in Zoho, it didn't happen. Untracked meetings don't count toward your metrics.
